decisions.reason: The award is an early positive signal, and for a large established metal firm the option value of remaining in a promising geothermal niche outweighs the likely low carrying cost.
As part of the geothermal product family, its market potential is still not fully revealed, so we would keep this option open at limited incremental cost.
This complementary surface technology supports the geothermal line, and without clear negative evidence we prefer to preserve the follow-on option for another year.
A fire-protection steel profile system is close to our core capabilities, so portfolio synergies and prior development effort favor keeping it on the market.
A slim steel profile system is a relatively low-cost extension of the existing range, so it is worth retaining until demand becomes clearer.
A decorative steel profile surface system is a niche but adjacent offering whose likely modest carrying cost justifies keeping the option alive for specification-driven projects.
